method: Index on p7 gives the section skeleton (Reading 9, Writing 19, Grammar 34, Literature 41, Model Question Papers 106). The contributor table on p8-9 lists all 16 literature texts: prose 1-8 in exactly the database chapter order, then poems 9-16. Six of those eight poems are pinned to a chapter independently by that chapter's own concept list, and they occupy contributor positions 11,12,13,14,15,16 for units 3,4,5,6,7,8 - a constant offset of +8. Positions 9 (Bharat Our Land) and 10 (Gifts of Grace) therefore belong to units 1 and 2. Every in-book boundary below was then located by the bold heading on the page, with its y-position on the 792pt page recorded so split pages are explicit.

No page in this block is single-chapter, so nothing here can be assigned by page range; it needs question-level attribution.
